name: British Columbia

known.via: English Wikipedia "British Columbia (wine)" (redirects to "British Columbia wine")

terms: Vintners Quality Alliance, the appellation system for Canadian wine from British Columbia and Ontario. It guarantees the wine's origin.
Made from grapes frozen naturally on the vine and picked at ⟦temp|18°F|−8°C⟧ or colder. Canada makes more than any other country, over 90% of it in Ontario.

blurb.text: A Canadian wine province that includes the Okanagan, Similkameen, Fraser and Cowichan valleys and Vancouver Island. Merlot and Pinot Noir are the most planted grapes, followed by Pinot Gris and Chardonnay.
